title: teucrium multiflorum var. angustifolium
intro: Teucrium multiflorum var. angustifolium, commonly known as a variety of the perennial herb Teucrium multiflorum, is a plant species within the family Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its traditional use in herbal medicine, where it is used to support the health of the digestive system and relieve symptoms associated with indigestion and gastrointestinal issues. The health benefits of Teucrium multiflorum var. angustifolium include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help protect against oxidative stress and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-spasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
